findings: No remaining blockers. Only the isolated PPO cap differs; production sources remain unchanged.
Normalization verifies original prefix checksum, footer step count and full trace checksum before normalizing the episode UUID and its dependent footer digest.
Reviewed validator reports 4,722 canonical trajectories, 98,304 decisions, 48 strict checkpoint restores and identical same-count model/Adam/RNG states.
All twelve runs perform 1,024 optimizer steps with two epochs per round and no failures, skips, KL early stops or unclean shutdown.
Reproduced all medians. Eighteen workers effectively ties sixteen; twenty-four and thirty-two take 7.97% and 15.66% longer overall.
Warm collection ranges overlap; cutoffs increase. No conclusion about learning quality or long-run performance.
independent_review.normalization: Episode UUID and its dependent completion checksum only; game observations, actions, outcomes and counts are retained.
independent_review.scope: Source-only semantic review and independent result arithmetic/artifact checks; owner executed validation.

limitations: Worker count changes RNG streams and episode cutoff boundaries; equal-budget workloads, not identical cross-count trajectories.
Three timing repetitions are not independent learner seeds. Order rotates but is not a fully balanced Latin square.
Warm collection uses the second 4096-decision rollout; long-run thermals and learning quality are not measured.
Parent peak RSS excludes the worker pool. Background activity is not controlled.
No validation/test gameplay, corpus generation or inspector export is included in training timing.
protocol.scope: Vantom combat training throughput from a frozen 250k rich-combat checkpoint; fresh optimizer and identical seed/cursor per timing repetition.
protocol.source_variant: Only the isolated PPO process limit is raised from 16 to 32; production defaults unchanged.
